title: Implement the termination-declaration and stop-assessment-result contracts (Phase 2a Task A vertical slice)
objective: Implement contracts/termination-declaration.schema.json and contracts/stop-assessment-result.schema.json exactly matching docs/contracts/termination-declaration.md and docs/contracts/stop-assessment-result.md, approved in docs/architecture/ADR-0003-phase-2-architecture-and-stop-assessment.md, which extends ADR-0002 (Status-line append only) and preserves ADR-0001/ADR-0002 without modifying their decision text. This task implements Task A only (single-trace deterministic stop assessment); Task B (baseline comparison, false-halt cost, ADR-0004, BaselineDefinition, BaselineComparisonResult, the future compare verb, and any diagnostic code beyond PT303, which belong to a fresh PT4xx block reserved for a future ADR-0004, never the remainder of the PT3xx range) is out of scope and must not be started, authored, or stubbed. Do not modify contracts/trace-envelope.schema.json, docs/contracts/trace-envelope.md, contracts/obligation-ledger.schema.json, docs/contracts/obligation-ledger.md, contracts/evaluation-result.schema.json, docs/contracts/evaluation-result.md, docs/architecture/ADR-0001-contract-first-modular-monolith.md, docs/architecture/ADR-0002-obligation-and-evaluation-contracts.md, docs/architecture/ADR-0003-phase-2-architecture-and-stop-assessment.md, docs/product-brief.md, docs/security.md, AGENTS.md, or tasks/phase-2a-stop-assessment.json; only the allowed_paths below may change, and a git diff of every one of those frozen paths against origin/main must be empty. TerminationDeclaration 1.0: root object, additionalProperties false, five required properties in canonical order schemaVersion (const '1.0'), traceId (non-empty string, must equal the paired trace envelope's traceId), terminationEventId (non-empty string, must dereference an events[].id in the paired trace envelope AND must be that trace's own maximum-canonical-rank event under the existing sequence-then-timestamp-instant-then-id-ordinal canonical order from docs/contracts/trace-envelope.md), terminationKind (non-empty string, exactly one of the fixed closed eight-value enum agent-self-reported-stop, harness-declared-stop, natural-completion, external-cancellation, timeout, crash-or-error, capture-truncated, unknown; no default, no other value or casing), and declarationSource (a required closed object with additionalProperties false placed after terminationKind in canonical root order, with exactly four required members always present in this exact nested order: producerType (string, exactly one of the closed four-value enum agent, harness, operator, adapter), producerName (non-empty string identifying the producing role/system; never echoed in any diagnostic Message, redacted exactly like the PT004 precedent; may be a non-personal role or opaque identifier for an operator), producerVersion (a non-empty string OR the JSON null literal; null is a valid distinct value when no meaningful software version exists and is never a PT101; an empty or whitespace-only string is a PT101; any non-string, non-null JSON type is a PT002), and evidenceBasis (string, exactly one of the closed four-value enum agent-output, harness-lifecycle, operator-annotation, adapter-inference)). declarationSource records who produced the declaration separately from terminationKind's record of the cause; it never requires the agent to emit the declaration and is never a confidence, quality, or truth score. It carries five closed coherence rules, each a single implication whose violation is a PT303: (1) terminationKind=agent-self-reported-stop requires evidenceBasis=agent-output; (2) terminationKind=harness-declared-stop requires evidenceBasis=harness-lifecycle; (3) producerType=agent requires evidenceBasis=agent-output; (4) producerType=operator requires evidenceBasis=operator-annotation; (5) evidenceBasis=adapter-inference requires producerType=adapter; every other combination is accepted so a harness or adapter may faithfully wrap evidence of a different origin (for example a harness or adapter producer carrying evidenceBasis=agent-output). terminationAttested remains the existing cause-commitment lookup over terminationKind, unchanged by declarationSource and independent of it; an adapter-inference declaration with a concrete attested cause stays a producer-supplied inference and is never relabeled as observed agent output or a direct agent assertion. Reuse PT000/PT001/PT002/PT003/PT004/PT005/PT100/PT101 unmodified in meaning (16 MiB TraceValidator.MaximumInputSizeBytes reuse, unknown/duplicate-property rejection including inside declarationSource, malformed-JSON short-circuit, unsupported-schemaVersion, empty-string/closed-enum invalid-value) exactly as docs/contracts/termination-declaration.md's Diagnostic registry fixes; PT001 also covers a missing declarationSource or any missing nested member; PT002 also covers a non-object declarationSource, a non-string/non-null producerVersion, and a wrong-typed producerType/producerName/evidenceBasis; PT003 also covers an unknown property inside declarationSource; and PT101 also covers an empty producerName, an empty producerVersion string, an out-of-enum producerType (message 'Producer type is not recognized.'), and an out-of-enum evidenceBasis (message 'Evidence basis is not recognized.') at their own nested pointers. Allocate exactly four new PT3xx codes with zero collision against existing PT1xx/PT2xx codes: PT300 dangling terminationEventId at pointer /terminationEventId; PT301 non-terminal terminationEventId (dereferences an existing event that is not the trace's maximum-canonical-rank event) at pointer /terminationEventId, never evaluated when PT300 already fired for the same field; PT302 traceId mismatch at pointer /traceId; PT303 declaration-source coherence violation (any of the five coherence rules above), with pointer /declarationSource/evidenceBasis when a single field alone establishes the violation (rules 1 and 2, anchored by the authoritative root-level terminationKind) and pointer /declarationSource otherwise (rules 3, 4, 5, which jointly couple producerType and evidenceBasis), one fixed safe Message ('TerminationDeclaration declarationSource is not coherent with the declared termination.') that never echoes any document value, evaluated only after producerType/evidenceBasis/terminationKind each validated as recognized enums, emitting one PT303 per violated rule in ascending rule number. No PT3xx code beyond PT303 is allocated, reserved for, or claimed by Task B; Task B's future BaselineDefinition-specific codes are reserved to a fresh PT4xx block allocated only by a future ADR-0004. Validation runs Phase A (structural, size/parse/duplicate-walk/root-type/unknown-property/required-type in the fixed schemaVersion-then-traceId-then-terminationEventId-then-terminationKind-then-declarationSource order, then schemaVersion/traceId/terminationEventId/terminationKind value checks in that order, then, only if declarationSource is a present object, its nested unknown-property check then its nested required presence/type checks in the fixed producerType-then-producerName-then-producerVersion-then-evidenceBasis order then its nested value checks producerType-then-producerName-then-producerVersion-then-evidenceBasis, then declarationSource coherence PT303 checks evaluated once in ascending rule number) then Phase B (traceId mismatch PT302, then dangling terminationEventId PT300, then non-terminal PT301 only if PT300 did not fire), exactly per docs/contracts/termination-declaration.md's Validation order section; every PT303 is a Phase A diagnostic and therefore always precedes any Phase B diagnostic; Phase B requires only the paired trace envelope, never the ledger, but the assess CLI still requires the ledger to validate fully before the declaration is ever opened. StopAssessmentResult 1.0: root object, additionalProperties false, thirteen required properties always present in this exact canonical order: schemaVersion (const '1.0'), traceId, algorithm (object: name const 'progresstrace-stop-assessor', version const '1.0.0'), terminationEventId (copied from the declaration), terminationKind (copied from the declaration), declarationSource (a closed object with additionalProperties false, placed immediately after terminationKind, copied by value from the validated declaration unchanged and in its exact nested order producerType, producerName, producerVersion, evidenceBasis; every member and the object itself are lineage class from-declaration, never derived, recomputed, reordered, or dropped; its presence preserves that an input was operator-annotated or adapter-inferred so downstream consumers cannot mistake it for a direct agent assertion), terminationAttested (boolean; true iff terminationKind is not capture-truncated and not unknown per the fixed lookup table in docs/contracts/termination-declaration.md's Termination attestation section; unknown is never treated as attested; independent of declarationSource and never a confidence score), terminationRank (integer >= 0; canonical rank of terminationEventId's dereferenced event; always N-1), obligationResults (array, one entry per ledger obligation in ledger array order, never empty), traceClassification (string enum progress/stagnation/regression/insufficient-evidence, the unmodified Phase 1 precedence rule recomputed by invoking ProgressTrace.Core.Evaluation.Evaluator directly against the validated trace+ledger; never read from a precomputed EvaluationResult file, since there is no fourth input), stopClassification (string enum on-target/late-termination/unmet-target-at-termination-present/incomplete-observation), safeStopRank (integer >= 0 or JSON null; represented in the schema as type ["integer","null"]), traceOverhead (integer >= 0 or JSON null, same type representation). Every obligationResults entry has exactly six required properties in this order: obligationId, classification (the same recomputed Phase 1 enum), evidenceEventIds (the same recomputed Phase 1 content/ordering rule from docs/contracts/evaluation-result.md), outcome (string enum stable-attainment/unmet-target-at-termination), stableAttainmentRank (integer >= 0 or null; null iff outcome=unmet-target-at-termination), overhead (integer >= 0 or null under the identical condition). Null is always represented as the JSON null literal at its fixed property slot, never by omitting the property and never by a sentinel like 0 or -1; every property listed above is unconditionally present. The stop-assessment-result documentation labels every field with exactly one of eight mutually exclusive artifact-lineage classes (contract-constant; from-trace; from-ledger; from-declaration; derived-from-declaration; derived-from-trace-and-declaration; derived-from-trace-and-ledger; derived-from-all-inputs) that name only source artifacts and the inputs a computation consumed, never truth, observation quality, producer identity, or evidence confidence; no epistemic class (observed, authored, or the like) is used. The fixed mapping, which must agree byte-for-concept with docs/contracts/stop-assessment-result.md and ADR-0003, is: schemaVersion, algorithm, algorithm.name, algorithm.version = contract-constant; traceId = from-trace; terminationEventId, terminationKind, declarationSource and every nested member = from-declaration; terminationAttested = derived-from-declaration; terminationRank = derived-from-trace-and-declaration; obligationResults membership and order and obligationId = from-ledger; classification, evidenceEventIds, outcome, stableAttainmentRank, traceClassification = derived-from-trace-and-ledger; overhead, stopClassification, safeStopRank, traceOverhead = derived-from-all-inputs. These labels are documentation-only: no runtime sourceClass property is added, and neither machine schema nor any fixture carries a provenance field. Per-obligation algorithm: for each obligation's existing Phase 1 total-ordered signals s1..sn (docs/contracts/obligation-ledger.md Signal total order, reused verbatim, no new tie-break), find the smallest index k such that every signal from sk through sn has status=satisfied; if no such k exists (including n=0, or sn != satisfied after any regression with no recovery) the obligation is unmet-target-at-termination with stableAttainmentRank=null and overhead=null; otherwise stableAttainmentRank = canonical rank of sk's dereferenced event, outcome=stable-attainment, overhead = terminationRank - stableAttainmentRank as a rank distance (never a raw events[].sequence delta: for ranks a<=b, b-a is the count of trace events with canonical rank strictly greater than a and less than or equal to b), always >= 0. Trace-level rollup, evaluated as the first matching condition in this exact order: (1) if terminationAttested=false (terminationKind is capture-truncated or unknown), stopClassification=incomplete-observation and safeStopRank=traceOverhead=null regardless of any obligation's outcome, even if every obligation is mechanically stable-attainment; per-obligation stableAttainmentRank/overhead are still computed and emitted in this case; (2) else if any obligation's outcome=unmet-target-at-termination, stopClassification=unmet-target-at-termination-present and safeStopRank=traceOverhead=null; (3) else safeStopRank = max(stableAttainmentRank) across all obligations, traceOverhead = terminationRank - safeStopRank as a rank distance, and stopClassification=late-termination if traceOverhead>0 else on-target. traceOverhead must never be computed as, or coincidentally validated against, a sum of obligationResults[].overhead values; a conformance assertion must explicitly prove the all-stable-rollup fixture's traceOverhead is the max-based value and is strictly less than the naive sum of its per-obligation overheads. Canonical serialization for both new contracts and their fixtures: UTF-8, no byte-order mark, no insignificant whitespace, exactly one trailing newline byte, fixed property order exactly as enumerated above and in both docs, byte-idempotent under repeated normalization (StopAssessmentResultNormalizer or equivalent, mirroring EvaluationResultNormalizer's structure without duplicating its code). Implement TerminationDeclarationValidator sharing TraceValidator/ObligationLedgerValidator's existing internal structural-validation helpers (unknown-property rejection, duplicate-property rejection, size-limit enforcement) rather than duplicating them, and a new deterministic stop-assessment algorithm in a new ProgressTrace.Core.Assessment namespace that invokes but never reimplements ProgressTrace.Core.Evaluation.Evaluator; no other namespace may reimplement canonical-rank, stable-attainment, rank-distance, or rollup logic. Add a fourth CLI verb, assess <trace-path> <ledger-path> <termination-declaration-path>, extending the usage line to 'progresstrace <validate|normalize> <path> | progresstrace evaluate <trace-path> <ledger-path> | progresstrace assess <trace-path> <ledger-path> <termination-declaration-path>' without altering existing verbs, with exact stdout/stderr shapes, document field values ('trace','ledger','declaration'), and 0/1/2 exit-code precedence fixed in docs/contracts/termination-declaration.md's CLI assess behavior section: trace validates fully (reusing TraceValidator unmodified) before ledger-path is ever opened; ledger validates fully (reusing ObligationLedgerValidator unmodified, Phase A then Phase B against the validated trace) before termination-declaration-path is ever opened; declaration validates Phase A then Phase B against the validated trace; only when all three produce zero diagnostics does assess compute and emit the canonical StopAssessmentResult with exit 0; a PT000 anywhere or any oversized/unreadable file yields exit 2 with the correct document label at the correct stage, never opening a later document; any other diagnostic on any document yields exit 1; bad usage (wrong argument count or unrecognized leading verb, including an assess invocation with an argument count other than 4) writes the usage error to stderr and exits 2 without opening any file. Because tests/ProgressTrace.ConformanceTests/SchemaConformance.cs's minimal JSON-Schema-subset validator currently supports only type values object/array/string and a single scalar 'type' string, and StopAssessmentResult introduces integer, boolean, and nullable (['integer','null']) typed fields with no existing precedent in contracts/trace-envelope.schema.json, contracts/obligation-ledger.schema.json, or contracts/evaluation-result.schema.json, extend SchemaConformance.MatchesType (and the 'type' handling in ValidateNode) to additionally support the primitive types 'integer', 'boolean', and 'null', and to support a JSON array value for the 'type' keyword (e.g. ['integer','null']) meaning the instance must match at least one listed type; do not add any new schema keyword name beyond the existing Supported allow-list, and do not change the existing object/array/string behavior used by the three frozen Phase 0/1 schemas, which must continue to validate identically. Fixture families, all under a new fixtures/termination/** subtree distinct from fixtures/valid/**, fixtures/invalid/**, and fixtures/obligations/**: (a) one new trace fixture fixtures/termination/traces/valid/non-contiguous-sequence-trace.json, a valid trace envelope with traceId synthetic-non-contiguous and exactly four events with non-contiguous raw sequence values 0, 5, 12, 20 (ids nc-evt-0..nc-evt-3 in that sequence order) to prove overhead/traceOverhead use canonical rank distance, never a raw sequence delta; (b) new ledger fixtures under fixtures/termination/ledgers/valid/: on-target-ledger.json (traceId synthetic-multi-event, pairs with the existing fixtures/valid/multi-event-trace.json, one obligation obl-a with a single signal at event-002=satisfied), mixed-rollup-ledger.json (traceId synthetic-multi-event, obligations obl-a [signal at event-002=satisfied] and obl-b [signal at event-001=open, final and only signal, non-satisfied]), late-termination-ledger.json (traceId synthetic-non-contiguous, obligation obl-a, single signal at nc-evt-0=satisfied), regression-no-recovery-ledger.json (traceId synthetic-non-contiguous, obligation obl-a, signals nc-evt-0=satisfied then nc-evt-1=regressed, final=regressed), regression-then-recovery-ledger.json (traceId synthetic-non-contiguous, obligation obl-a, signals nc-evt-0=satisfied, nc-evt-1=regressed, nc-evt-2=satisfied, final=satisfied, proving stableAttainmentRank is the later re-attainment's rank 2, not the first attainment's rank 0), all-stable-rollup-ledger.json (traceId synthetic-non-contiguous, obligations obl-a [signal at nc-evt-0=satisfied, stableAttainmentRank=0] and obl-b [signal at nc-evt-2=satisfied, stableAttainmentRank=2], proving safeStopRank=max(0,2)=2 and, against termination at rank 3, traceOverhead=1, strictly less than the naive per-obligation overhead sum of 3+1=4); (c) new termination-declaration valid fixtures under fixtures/termination/valid/, each name ending in '-declaration.json': on-target-declaration.json (traceId synthetic-multi-event, terminationEventId event-002, terminationKind natural-completion; pairs with multi-event-trace.json + the existing fixtures/obligations/valid/insufficient-evidence-ledger.json, proving a zero-signal obligation is unmet-target-at-termination with stableAttainmentRank=null and overhead=null), mixed-rollup-declaration.json (traceId synthetic-multi-event, terminationEventId event-002, terminationKind timeout; pairs with multi-event-trace.json + mixed-rollup-ledger.json, proving stopClassification=unmet-target-at-termination-present overrides even though obl-a is individually stable), late-termination-declaration.json (traceId synthetic-non-contiguous, terminationEventId nc-evt-3, terminationKind agent-self-reported-stop; pairs with regression-no-recovery-ledger.json, proving unmet-target-at-termination via regression with no recovery), regression-then-recovery-declaration.json (same trace, terminationKind external-cancellation; pairs with regression-then-recovery-ledger.json, proving stable-attainment at rank 2 with overhead=1), all-stable-rollup-declaration.json (same trace, terminationKind agent-self-reported-stop; pairs with all-stable-rollup-ledger.json, proving the non-summed safeStopRank/traceOverhead formula). Every valid declaration fixture in (c) MUST include a coherent declarationSource, and the nine fixtures together MUST cover all four producerType values, all four evidenceBasis values, at least one null producerVersion, and at least one adapter-inference with a concrete attested cause (its cause never relabeled as a direct agent assertion): on-target-declaration.json {producerType harness, producerName example-harness, producerVersion '2.3.0', evidenceBasis harness-lifecycle}; capture-truncated-declaration.json {producerType adapter, producerName example-otel-adapter, producerVersion '0.9.1', evidenceBasis adapter-inference}; unknown-declaration.json {producerType operator, producerName release-operator-role (a non-personal role, not a person), producerVersion null, evidenceBasis operator-annotation}; zero-signal-declaration.json {producerType adapter, producerName example-crash-adapter, producerVersion '1.2.0', evidenceBasis adapter-inference} — the adapter-inference-with-concrete-attested-cause case (crash-or-error), whose terminationAttested stays true and whose cause stays a producer-supplied inference, never relabeled a direct agent assertion; mixed-rollup-declaration.json {producerType harness, producerName example-harness, producerVersion '2.3.0', evidenceBasis harness-lifecycle}; late-termination-declaration.json {producerType agent, producerName example-agent, producerVersion '1.0.0', evidenceBasis agent-output}; regression-no-recovery-declaration.json {producerType harness, producerName example-harness, producerVersion '2.3.0', evidenceBasis harness-lifecycle}; regression-then-recovery-declaration.json {producerType operator, producerName release-operator-role, producerVersion null, evidenceBasis operator-annotation}; all-stable-rollup-declaration.json {producerType agent, producerName example-agent, producerVersion '1.0.0', evidenceBasis agent-output}.
